description:
Cast Omarthis by paying {2}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, copying the Omarthis spell, with the copy being nonlegendary.
Resolve the copy of the Omarthis spell, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the original Omarthis spell, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
The token Omarthis' first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
The nontoken Omarthis' first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 5.
